CATALOG.INSTAGRAM_DESC: Connect with username and password. Experimental connector.
CATALOG.MESSENGER_DESC: Connect with username and password. Experimental connector.
CATALOG.TIKTOK_DESC: Connect by scanning a QR code. Experimental connector.
CATALOG.WHATSAPP_DESC: Connect by scanning a QR code or pairing code. Experimental connector.

MODE.OFFICIAL_DESC: Uses the official integration of the platform. Safest option, recommended whenever available.
MODE.EXPERIMENTAL_DESC: Signs in with your account like a regular app. Works where the official option is not available, with risks.

INFO.REQUIREMENTS_PASSWORD: The username and password of the account. If the account uses two-factor authentication, keep your phone at hand.
INFO.REQUIREMENTS_QR: A phone with the app installed and signed in to the account, to scan the QR code.
INFO.LIMITATIONS_TEXT: Text messages are supported. Behavior may change when the platform updates.
INFO.LIMITATIONS_MEDIA: Media, groups and reactions are only available once they have been tested.
INFO.RISK_BLOCK: The platform may block or limit the account.
INFO.RISK_OWN_ACCOUNT: Use an account of your own, never a customer account.
INFO.RISK_2FA: Do not turn off two-factor authentication (2FA).
INFO.CONSENT: I understand the risks and agree to connect this account experimentally.

STEPS.CREDENTIALS_HELP: Sign in with the account you want to connect.
STEPS.CODE_HELP: Enter the verification code sent by the platform (SMS or authenticator app).
STEPS.PASSWORD_NOT_STORED: Your password is sent securely and is never stored.
STEPS.APPROVAL_HELP: Open the app on your phone and approve the sign-in attempt. This page continues on its own.
STEPS.QR_ALT: QR code to connect the account
STEPS.QR_HELP_TIKTOK: On your phone: TikTok > Profile > ☰ > QR code, then scan this code.
STEPS.QR_HELP_WHATSAPP: On your phone: WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device, then scan this code.
STEPS.QR_HELP_INSTAGRAM: Scan this code with the app.
STEPS.QR_HELP_MESSENGER: Scan this code with the app.
STEPS.PAIRING_HELP: On your phone: WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link with phone number, then type this code.
STEPS.SYNC_HELP: Importing your recent conversations. You can keep this page open.
STEPS.CHOICE_HELP: The platform asks you to choose how to continue.
STEPS.CAPTCHA_HELP: Type the characters in the image to prove you are not a robot.

FINALIZE.HELP: Almost done. Choose how this inbox will work.
FINALIZE.NAME: Inbox name
FINALIZE.TEAM_HINT: New conversations go to this team.

ERRORS.WRONG_PASSWORD: Wrong username or password. Check them and try again.
ERRORS.WRONG_CODE: That code is incorrect. Check the latest code and try again.
ERRORS.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: The account is locked. Unlock it in the official app and try again later.
ERRORS.CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED: The platform asked for a security check. Open the official app, complete the check and try again.
ERRORS.TIMEOUT: Time ran out. Start the connection again.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again, to avoid blocking the account.
ERRORS.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The platform is not responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
ERRORS.UNSUPPORTED_STEP: This sign-in step is not supported. Use the official option or contact support.
ERRORS.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
ERRORS.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that account. Check the username or email and try again.
ERRORS.LOGIN_REJECTED: The platform rejected the login. Check the details, complete any verification in the official app and try again.
ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA: The characters in the image do not match. Try again.

PANEL.TITLE: Connection
PANEL.CONFIRM_DISCONNECT: Disconnect this account? You will stop receiving messages until you reconnect. Conversations are kept.
PANEL.CONFIRM_REVOKE: Revoke access? The session is removed and the account must sign in again to use this inbox.
